description_en: Adds Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances as compute nodes to Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) clusters

kebab_example: aliyun ehpc attach-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-xxxxxxx --queue-name comp --compute-node '{"ImageId":"m-bp1h765oyqyxxxxxxxxx","InstanceIds":["i-xxxxxxxx"]}' --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
